sys_app.author: Integration Architecture Team
sys_app.description:
Production-ready VMware vCenter to ServiceNow CMDB integration using IntegrationHub ETL and Service Graph Connector framework principles. Supports vCenter REST API v7/v8 via MID Server with IRE-based CI identification and reconciliation.
Scope Objects: - 11 Script Includes (ETL pipeline components) - 9 Custom Tables (8 staging + log/run) - 8 Transform Maps (one per CI type) - 1 Scheduled Job (daily 00:00-02:00) - 1 Business Rule (CI retirement cascade) - 15 System Properties - 1 Connection Alias definition - Flow Designer flows (3)
Supported CI Types: - cmdb_ci_vcenter (vCenter Instance) - cmdb_ci_datacenter (Datacenter) - cmdb_ci_cluster (Compute Cluster) - cmdb_ci_esx_server (ESXi Host) - cmdb_ci_vmware_instance (Virtual Machine) - cmdb_ci_datastore (Datastore) - cmdb_ci_storage_pool (Datastore Cluster) - cmdb_ci_dvs_switch (Distributed vSwitch)
sys_app.name: vCenter CMDB ETL (FT1)
sys_app.short_description: VMware vCenter → ServiceNow CMDB via IH ETL
